name: Familiar Bond
body:
You gain a familiar, as the wizard arcane bond class feature. Your familiar must be a monster you have captured that qualifies to be a wizard’s familiar (Improved Familiar still grants you access to more possible familiars as well). When you call upon it as your active monster, the chosen monster functions as a familiar and still grants you trainer spells.
